en: A sepia-toned image showing a devastated urban street with heavily damaged and ruined buildings. Rubble and debris cover the ground, with roofless walls and chimneys still standing. On the right is a distinctive rounded modern building with many broken windows. The overall scene suggests wartime destruction. Along the bottom margin there is printed Dutch text identifying the location in Nijmegen.
